summary: Full backend + frontend e2e on Auxible India 3D dark redesign with NEW features (Jobs, Venues, Analytics, Delete-Update). Backend pytest 19/19 PASS across Venues CRUD, Jobs CRUD with role-based filtering, Analytics KPIs/charts, and Delete Update (owner + admin). Frontend Playwright covers admin login -> Live Monitor, Jobs Schedule dialog (venue type select + tech select + date), Venues Add dialog, Analytics KPIs + 3 charts, Updates Feed, then employee login with geolocation, Check-In, Jobs tab, Updates tab, Alerts tab. All happy paths working.

minor.issue: updates_last_7_days uses string comparison {timestamp: {$gte: 'YYYY-MM-DD', $lt: 'YYYY-MM-DDT99'}} relying on ISO prefix ordering; works because ISO datetimes start with the date, but is fragile. Prefer comparing against day-start and next-day datetime ISO.
Same fragile YYYY-MM-DD string vs ISO datetime comparison for updates_today (carry-over from iter 1).
Job has no validation that assigned_to is an actual employee user_id; an invalid ObjectId would 500 the serializer. Consider validating existence + role on create.

issues: Leaflet tiles fail to load (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for CartoDB) inside sandbox/preview egress, leaving map area blank. App is fine; consider self-hosting tiles or showing a placeholder when tile load fails.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — console warning. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} explicit.

action_items: (Optional) Harden date filters in /api/admin/analytics and /api/admin/stats to compare against datetime ISO bounds rather than YYYY-MM-DD string prefixes.
(Optional) Validate assigned_to on POST /api/jobs (must exist and be role='employee').
(Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to admin Add-Job and Add-Venue dialogs.
(Optional) Provide a graceful fallback / self-hosted tiles for Leaflet when external CartoDB tile CDN is unreachable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: jobs.serialize_job assumes assigned_to is a valid ObjectId string — bad input from API will 500. Wrap ObjectId() in try/except or validate input.

server.py: PATCH /api/jobs/{id} for employees silently filters non-allowed fields. Returning 403 or 422 for forbidden field attempts would be more explicit (currently it just ignores them, which is fine but inconsistent with other endpoints).
Analytics groups by venue_type with default 'Other' and status default 'Scheduled' — bucketing is fine but the pie chart will mis-label legacy 'unknown' jobs as 'Other' silently.
Leaflet tile URLs are hardcoded to external CDN (cartodb-basemaps) — works in prod but blocks in restricted networks; consider env-driven tile URL.
Login endpoint still lacks brute-force lockout (carry-over from iter 1). Not in problem statement but called out in playbook.

rca of the issue: No real bugs found. All 19 new backend endpoints (Venues CRUD, Jobs CRUD, Analytics, DELETE /updates) work as specified including role-based read filtering (employee sees only own jobs) and write protection (employee patch on own job can only touch status/notes; venue_name change attempt was correctly ignored). Frontend create+list+delete cycles for Jobs and Venues work via the documented data-testids, Analytics renders KPIs and recharts (pie/bar/area) without errors even with 2 jobs / 2 venues / 1 employee. The only environmental issue is external Leaflet tile fetch failing in sandbox — cosmetic, not a defect.
